players.name: Drex Max 1.1
players.note: Nace.AI's Drex Max 1.1 (drex-max-v1.1; no open weights) through Nace's hosted System One endpoint (https://console.nace.ai/v1/systemone); price = Nace's list price, $0.06 per million input tokens, output not billed (nace.ai/drex, read 2026-11-05); Nace bills the launch price, $0.03 per million (console.nace.ai/docs/drex/reference/pricing, read 2026-11-05). At most 25 options per request. Pre-send cap on its Nace requests: a ledger shared with the other hosted Drex setup reserves each attempt's worst case (one input token per request byte plus 4,096, at the billed price) before sending and refuses past $1.25 spent + reserved; error answers other than Nace's documented unbilled statuses keep the worst case.
